notes: Links disease id (from disease_database.json) to crop with scientific name and source. Every PlantVillage disease class is inherently already crop-specific in its model_label, so this file is most useful for cross-crop pathogens (e.g., Phytophthora infestans and Alternaria solani both affect tomato AND potato) - flagging where management CANNOT be assumed to transfer across crops without separate verification.

records.cross_crop_note: Same pathogen also causes potato_late_blight. Chemical guidance is verified for TOMATO only in this batch (TNAU source); do NOT assume identical dosing is approved/appropriate for potato without separate label/source confirmation.

Same pathogen genus also causes tomato_early_blight (tomato_early_blight record is currently a NOT VERIFIED skeleton). Chemical guidance is verified for POTATO only in this batch (TNAU source); do NOT assume identical dosing applies to tomato.
